verdict.rationale: Every Gitea instance serves a downloadable Swagger 2.0 document at /swagger.v1.json and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /openapi3.v1.json. Both were live-verified on gitea.com, alongside a built-in Swagger UI and an API usage guide that points to the spec. The probe 404s were against docs.gitea.com paths, not instance paths, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of using the spec, and any deprecation or backward-compatibility statement for the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: the Swagger 2.0 document at /swagger.v1.json (342 paths, basePath /api/v1) and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /openapi3.v1.json
